definitions.explanation: The revival of art, learning and classical culture that began in Italy in the fourteenth century and spread across Europe. Also used figuratively for any revival or new flowering of something.

ルネサンス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ルネサンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧で、⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Leonardo da Vinci was a leading artist of the Renaissance and a scientist as well.

notes:
From French renaissance (rebirth). The older spelling ルネッサンス is still seen, especially in product names and figurative uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ルネサンス⟦{期|き}→〜期：32470_ki⟧: the Renaissance period
- ルネサンス⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧: Renaissance art
- ルネサンス⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: Renaissance architecture
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルネサンス: a renaissance of ~ (figurative)
